items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Now, according to Jell-Anne, he talks about a home... [INTERVIEWEE] No, I wouldn't know anything about that. See, I wouldn't know.

ctx.x: No. And you see, my cousins had taken him out of his home to their home. And he wasn't used to that little bathtub without that ring on the side. Well, you can catch on. She's a new bathtub you can't catch on.

No, that's right. So he just slipped and— Well, I was going to ask about the different homes that you were raised. Now, according to Jell-Anne, he talks about a home— On Frenchman Street, doesn't he? A Frenchman and we're Robertson. And this is— Yeah, well, that's the— November is 1443 at the corner of Robertson. I just wondered if—
No, I wouldn't know anything about that. See, I wouldn't know. I was a baby.
